title: KYC, folio, nomination and investor services
objectives: List the onboarding documents and the role of KYC.
body_md:
## KYC and onboarding

- **KYC** is mandatory for every investor, done once through a KYC Registration Agency (KRA).
- Documents: **PAN**, proof of identity and address, photo, bank details.
- **FATCA/CRS** declarations identify tax residence.
- **Minors** invest through a guardian; **joint holders** can be 'any one or survivor' or 'joint'.

## Folio

A **folio** is the investor's account number with an AMC. One investor may hold several folios across AMCs.

## Nomination

Nomination (or a declaration to opt out) is required. A nominee receives the units on the death of the holder.

## Statements

- **Account statement** after each transaction.
- **Consolidated Account Statement (CAS)** across AMCs, monthly when there are transactions.
- Half-yearly portfolio and annual reports.

## Changes

Updating address, bank mandate or nominee needs proper documentation.

> **Exam tip:** KYC is a one-time process; a folio is per AMC.
example: An investor invests with two AMCs. She has two folios but one KYC and one CAS that shows both.
say: You need KYC once; it works across fund houses.
Please add a nominee so your family can claim easily.
never: A separate KYC is needed for every fund house.
